This actual Boolean function has full affine spectral dimension r+m, minimum influence over its full affine Fourier-label orbit, H=2m, I=2r/M+m/2, and original data coordinates 2,3 satisfy C_2=C_3=0 but C_{23}=2/M>0. Both restrictions at either coordinate retain entropy 2m and have influence I-2/M>0, hence strictly larger H/I. Therefore affine minimality and full affine span, even with Booleanity, do not imply any finite-multiple singleton domination at every physical pair; actual descendant criticality excludes this family.
